criterion_order: Access and use IANA Root Zone Database .museum delegation record page
Respect constraints (no registration/contact; stop after five fields)
criterion_descriptions: Navigate to and use the IANA Root Zone Database delegation record for .museum (e.g., https://www.iana.org/domains/root/db/museum.html). Full credit if the agent clearly indicates it used that page as the source. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent attempts to access the IANA page but it is blocked/down/unreachable and the agent explicitly reports this limitation; in that case, the agent may use an alternative source only if it clearly states IANA was inaccessible and distinguishes what came from the alternative source.

Report the TLD type shown on the .museum delegation record, preserving the value as displayed. Full credit if correct. If the IANA page is inaccessible or the field is not visible/present, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not retrieve/confirm the type due to that limitation (do not guess).

Report the sponsoring organization exactly as displayed on the .museum delegation record (preserve spelling/casing). Full credit if correct. If the IANA page is inaccessible or the field is not visible/present, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not retrieve/confirm the sponsoring organization due to that limitation (do not guess).

Report the registration date shown on the .museum delegation record and ensure it is the registration date (not the last-updated date). Full credit if the correct registration date is provided. If the IANA page is inaccessible or the registration date is not visible/present, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not retrieve/confirm the registration date due to that limitation (do not substitute last-updated date; do not guess).

Report the WHOIS server exactly as displayed on the .museum delegation record (preserve formatting). Full credit if correct. If the IANA page is inaccessible or the field is not visible/present, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not retrieve/confirm the WHOIS server due to that limitation (do not guess).

Report the registration-services website URL as displayed on the .museum delegation record. Full credit if correct. If the IANA page is inaccessible or the field is not visible/present, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not retrieve/confirm the registration-services website due to that limitation (do not guess).

Adhere to constraints: do not initiate domain registration or contact the registry; and stop after providing the five requested fields (type, sponsoring organization, registration date, WHOIS server, registration-services website). Full credit if no prohibited actions are taken and the response does not add extra registry fields beyond the requested five (minor formatting differences like headings/ordering are OK). Partial credit if extra non-contact, non-transactional details are included but constraints are otherwise respected. No credit if the agent attempts registration, reaches out to the registry, or otherwise violates constraints.
